item.title: Brant mayor loses one day's pay, encouraged to apologize for remarks
item.description: County of Brant Mayor David Bailey will lose one day's pay and is encouraged to apologize to two women who filed a complaint with the county's integrity commissioner.

item.title: Poppy Project brings community together to create public art piece
item.description: Community members came together in droves Saturday evening to create a public art piece to honour veterans. The Brantford Poppy Project’s inaugural workshop at the Thorpe Brothers Carriage House was packed with people of all ages who began to knit or crochet poppies.
